description: Make a model web-ready in one call: decimate every mesh proportionally to hit a triangle budget, scale oversized textures down, purge datablocks nothing references, and compress the mesh streams with meshopt (or Draco) on the way out. Returns before and after triangle counts, texture bytes and file size, plus what each step did, so the trade is visible rather than guessed. The input file is never modified. Decimation is collapse-based and preserves vertex groups, but a heavily decimated skinned mesh should be checked with blender_render before shipping.

compress.description: Mesh compression for a .glb/.gltf output. "meshopt" (default) is what the three.ws runtime and every major web viewer decode. Ignored for other formats.

input.description: Path to the model to optimize.

max_texture_px.description: Longest edge any texture may keep, e.g. 1024. Omit to leave textures untouched.

max_triangles.description: Triangle budget for the whole scene. Omit to leave geometry untouched.

output.description: Destination. The extension picks the format. Defaults to a .glb in the server workdir.

name: blender_optimize
title: Shrink a 3D model for delivery
